status: user reports inconsistent foliage overlap; bounded static layout audit, no repair applied

user_image.observation: Uneven blade overlap with abrupt dark wedges and visible gaps

static_layout_measurements.method: Decode scene160; take appended five-vertex blades in receipt order; undo each placement quarter-turn to obtain tangent/normal axes; compute full-blade X/Z AABBs; compare successive blades only when quarter-turn agrees
static_layout_measurements.scope: Whole mesh, not localized to screenshot blades. Full-height AABB overlap is not proof of triangle intersection, same-height coverage, occlusion or z-fighting.

interpretation.confirmed: Placement spacing and depth vary independently of the chosen blade dimensions and neighbouring geometry, producing highly variable tangent-envelope overlap.
interpretation.inferred: The uncontrolled overlap and depth arrangement plausibly contribute to the inconsistent layering in the supplied screenshot.
interpretation.unknown: Which measured crossing pairs correspond to the supplied crop pixels, and any additional contribution from retained donor shading, material-dependent drawing, depth interpolation or draw order. A still image alone does not establish z-fighting.

closeup_followup.user_clarification: Gaps are secondary; hard triangular overlap cut-ins are the concern
closeup_followup.native_submission_check: File group order is 80 tag0x8166 stem quads, 259 tag0x8163 tips, then 179 tag0x162 stem quads. This is source grouping, not proof of GPU draw order or bad depth state; no native emitted-index trace was run.
closeup_followup.conclusion: Actual geometric crossings exist under both conventional quad decompositions, supplying a stronger candidate for the cut-ins than tangent-envelope overlap alone.
closeup_followup.limits: Not screenshot face/pixel localization, native emitted-index validation, or proof that every geometric crossing is visually objectionable. Excludes coplanar and endpoint-only contacts.

next_discriminator: Prioritize intersection-aware consistent layering while retaining dense visual coverage, source attributes and repaired collision.
